activity.notes: This preserves the pre-221 strategist/administrator phase of the legacy Activity without extending the later chancellorship or regency backward. Zhuge Liang was a senior adviser and administrator of Liu Bei's faction during the Yi Province campaign and consolidation period. Shu Han is retained as the project-level umbrella label for the faction before its formal establishment.

sources.title: Zhuge Liang — ChinaKnowledge.de
sources.citation_text: ChinaKnowledge records Zhuge Liang as Liu Bei's senior military-political adviser, appointed Counsellor-in-chief in 221 and effectively regent under Liu Shan after Liu Bei's death.
